fixed_on: 2026-10-07, before the first protocol run (the smoke run checks the deck and the cost only)

protocol.laplace_number_definition: La = rho*gamma*D/mu^2 with D = 2R, as static_drop_2d: mu = 0.05 for rho = gamma = R = 1. Oh = mu/sqrt(rho*gamma*R) = 0.05; eps = nu/(omega0 R^2) = 0.0204. Exact normal mode: omega = 2.42587 (omega0 - 0.96%), beta = 0.177334 (2 n (n-1) nu/R^2 - 11.3%); beta/omega = 0.073, so 4 periods damp the mode to 0.16 of its initial amplitude (chosen to match the capillary-wave protocol, where 4 periods leave 0.13). Vorticity layer sqrt(2 nu/omega0) = 0.20 R = 1.6/3.2/6.5 h at R/h = 8/16/32.
protocol.amplitude_note: r = R0 (1 + eps cos(2 theta)), R0 = R/sqrt(1 + eps^2/2), eps = 0.01. Finite-amplitude frequency shift from the fully nonlinear inviscid drop (finite_amplitude.py): omega/omega0 - 1 = -0.770 eps^2 = -7.7e-5 at eps = 0.01, 260 times below the frequency limit and 26 times below the time-step limit. The mesh-induced cos(2 theta) moment of the relaxed static drop (M2 runs, R/h = 8) is 5e-6 R, 0.05% of a0.
protocol.time_step: As D13/D19 for the capillary wave: the lagged normal-increment capillary term is on (Surface_tension_semi_implicit = NormalIncrement) and every level uses one step, a fixed number of steps per inviscid period 2*pi/omega0. Here 100 steps per period (not 50): dt = 2.565e-2, 400 steps, outputs every 4 steps (100 outputs); dt = 2.1/5.8/16.5 times the one-sided capillary limit at R/h = 8/16/32. Reason, fixed before any protocol run: the mode-2 wavelength pi R is resolved by 25/50/100 cells at R/h = 8/16/32, finer than the capillary wave's lambda/h = 16/32/64, so the spatial frequency error at the finest level is expected to fall below the 50-steps-per-period time error (-0.13% in frequency, -0.36% in damping, measured on the capillary wave, job 46704019 and verify_D20.json). A shared time error of that size would cap the observed spatial order over 8/16/32 (D10 asks for the spatial study with the time error removed); at 100 steps per period it is about four times smaller (-0.03%, -0.09%). The check at 200 steps per period is generate_case.py --dt-divisor 2.
protocol.capillary_form: surface_stress (SurfaceStress, D2 candidate a); the KAG forms are generated but not part of this protocol
protocol.transport: pde_extension: harmonic PDE velocity extension with monolithic coupling (D9, D15)
protocol.sign_definite_patch_bounds: off, the solver default (D21 enables them for the sessile drop only; this case has no contact line)
protocol.reference: Exact linear viscous initial-value solution of the released 2D drop (drop_reference.py: residue sum of the Laplace transform; normal mode checked against the inviscid, weak-viscosity, Stokes and planar limits and against an independent Chebyshev collocation), evaluated at R_eff = sqrt(A_h(0)/pi), the equilibrium radius of the sampled drop, and fitted with the same damped-cosine model on the same output times as the simulation
protocol.note: Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, transport, Laplace number, dt divisor) spatial study at one shared time step; the divisor-1 study needs every level, the divisor-2 study the levels in time_step_criterion.refined_step_levels. Runs: 4 MPI ranks at R/h = 16 and 32, serial at R/h = 8.

criteria.definition: |omega_sim - omega_ref| / omega_ref. omega_sim is the angular frequency of the least-squares fit exp(-beta t)(c1 cos(omega t) + c2 sin(omega t)) to the mode-2 amplitude a_h(t) = Re M_2 / (pi R_A^3) over all outputs including t = 0, with M_2 the second harmonic moment of the P1 liquid region about its centroid and R_A = sqrt(A/pi); omega_ref is the same fit to the exact linear history at R_eff sampled at the same times.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(R/h) over order_levels, on the spatial study at the shared time step (D10); pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: frequency error <= 2% with convergence), applied at R/h = 32 with an observed order of at least 1 over 8/16/32, as for the capillary wave.

criteria.definition: |beta_sim - beta_ref| / beta_ref with beta the amplitude decay rate of the same two fits.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(R/h) over order_levels, on the spatial study at the shared time step (D10); pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: damping error <= 5% with convergence), at the finest level R/h = 32 as decision D20 does for the capillary wave (and M2 and D12), with an observed order of at least 1 over 8/16/32.

criteria.definition: max over the whole run of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0) (decision D11): over all VTU outputs and, when solver_run.log[.gz] is present, over the per-step 'Wet volume diagnostic' areas of every accepted step. A is the exact area of {phi_h < 0}; A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5: volume drift <= 1e-4, as for M1, M2 and the capillary wave), gated on the maximum deviation over the run (decision D11).

time_step_criterion.source: Decision D19 (M3): every gate passes in both studies, and the fitted frequency and damping change by at most 0.2% and 1% when the step is halved, at the finest level.
time_step_criterion.definition: |q(dt) - q(dt/2)| / |q(dt/2)| for the frequency omega and the damping rate beta of the damped-cosine fit to the simulated a_h(t), between the dt divisor 1 and 2 runs of one (capillary form, transport, Laplace number) at their finest common level.
time_step_criterion.at_level: finest common level of the dt and dt/2 runs (protocol: R/h = 32)
time_step_criterion.gates_at_each_step: every criterion applies to the dt study (all levels) and to the dt/2 study at the levels in refined_step_levels; criteria at levels not run at dt/2 are reported as not run
time_step_criterion.when_one_divisor_only: reported as not evaluated; does not fail
